item.title: 🌊🍕HTML Day — Hamburg — 2026
item.description:
HTML<tag>
(Hamburg-)​Moorburg 2026

When?

8. August 2026
13:00 (CET+1)
(communal bike ride at 12:30🚲)

Where?

Moorburger Elbdeich 361, 21079 Hamburg

How to get there?

By Bike

It’s a lovely bike ride (30–45 minutes) from the city through the old Elbtunnel, harbour, crossing a couple of bridges and riding on the Deich.
We will meet at Landungsbrücken for a communal bike ride at 12:30 and cycle together to Moorburg.

Public transport

The Bus 250 goes from Bf. Altona and takes about 25 minutes to Moorburger Kreuzung which is about 5 minutes walking distance to the place.

What?

Write HTML, have a slice of pizza🍕 and join in the worldwide energy!❇️

What to bring?
  • Yourself.
  • A friend?
  • A computer or pen and paper.
  • A topping you’d like to see on pizza?
Updates?

Follow our RSS feed.

Contact?

Signal Group

Not in Hamburg?

Find or organize your own event! https://html.energy/events.html.

ℹ️ Info ℹ️

What is this? This is the live update of the communal bike ride to Moorburg, where we will celebrate the 2026 edition of HTML day. It will be live-updated on August 8, 2026. Come and join the ride 🚲!
How do I join the ride? Come to one of the spots on the map a little before the specified times (on HTML day [August 8, 2026]). We will pick you up and ride with you to our destination in Moorburg.
How does this work? The site fetches Simon’s Mastodon feed. On HTML day we will regulary update the feed and post our current location. This info will be mapped to both the progress indicator at the top of the page and the map below.
